components.name: Grade badge
components.description: Grade letter on its ramp colour; pair with health and label on first mention.
components.css: .nx-grade { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:28px; min-width:44px; padding:0 10px; border-radius:9999px; background:oklch(0.58 0.125 138); color:#fff; font:600 14px/1 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Forest pill for the main action on light surfaces.
components.css: .nx-btn { height:40px; padding:0 20px; border:0; border-radius:9999px; background:oklch(0.31 0.062 148); color:oklch(0.97 0.025 118); font:500 14px 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; } .nx-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

narrative.northStar: Living land as a calm, credible instrument
narrative.overview: The site's own satellite image is the ground of every key card; numbers sit on it like a field instrument's readout. A light land layer for browsing and backing sites, a dark machine layer for the AI's work.
keyCharacteristics: Lichen ground, off-white cards, forest ink
Blurred Sentinel-2 imagery as card grounds
Dark machine layer for pipeline, trace and ledger

rules.name: Grade ramp, not traffic light
rules.body: Greens through olive and mustard to clay; always with letter, score and label.

rules.name: Serif for names, sans for numbers
rules.body: Places and pages use Instrument Serif; every number is tabular Hanken Grotesk.

rules.name: Glass only on photographs
rules.body: Backdrop blur appears only over satellite imagery.

dos: Show every value as a range with midpoint and confidence
Label replayed AI runs and sample news
donts: No red/green ticker or neon trading styling
No emoji icons, gradient text or coloured side borders
